Noodle Lab

Description

Sip, stir and customize your very own bowl of ramen at the Noodle Lab. Find a variety of ramen noodles, fresh ingredients and flavors, conveniently located inside the Texas Union. Whether you’re looking for a quick lunch or an after-class snack, this self-serve station offers plenty of noodle and ingredient options to elevate your dish.
